planner: AI planner through the local Python bench API
lookup_table_step_check: Passed upward and downward steps across the session range
limits: Some recorded speed-ripple readings exceeded the 3% objective. The session is bench tuning evidence, not flight qualification or proof that every target was met.
method: Sweep commanded speed at fixed duty, inspect current and synchronism, choose a duty-to-speed lookup table, then verify transitions.
control_architecture: AI selects and evaluates trials; the ESC generates motor waveforms locally. In the true open-loop mode the commanded electrical angle is not continuously corrected by rotor feedback.
